test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

FINAL
solution: The correct answer is '**Concluding**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Final**' is '**Concluding**'. • **Final**: last (in a series). [अंतिम (क्रम की दृष्टि से)] • *Example: This will be the **final** lesson of our course.* • **Concluding**: to end or to bring something to an end. (समाप्‍त करना या होना) • *Example: The President **concluded** his tour with a visit to a charity concert.* **Correct Answer:__** *Concluding.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Forbidden**: to not allow something. (किसी बात की मनाही होना; निषिद्घ, वर्जित होना) • **Former**: of an earlier time; belonging to the past. (पूर्वकाल का; अतीतकालीन) • **Allowed**: to give permission for somebody/something to do something or for something to happen. (कुछ करने की अनुमति देना, कुछ होने देना) 17a:T55a, The correct answer is **'A challenging situation'.**
